title: Rules and Regulations: Termination of Payment Arrangements on a Final Bill or a PrePay Power Enrollment
content:
**Rules and Regulations — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): termination**

**(a) Grounds.** An active agreement is terminated when its service account is final billed (termination reason: final bill) or enrolls in PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) (termination reason: PrePay Power enrollment). The agreement passes from active to terminated status.

**(b) Unbilled balance.** The unbilled balance is billed back on the service account with the same reason. On a PrePay Power enrollment it then forms part of the arrears transferred under the PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) rules, and on a final bill it becomes part of the final balance.

**(c) Standing of a termination.** A termination is not a default and does not count against later offers.

| Event on the service account | Termination reason | Where the billed-back balance goes |
|---|---|---|
| final bill | final bill | part of the final balance |
| enrollment in PrePay Power | PrePay Power enrollment | part of the arrears transferred under the PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) rules |

*Hypothetical:* a member moving off a farm home account while an agreement still holds $210.00 unbilled sees the agreement terminated on the final bill, the $210.00 billed back with the reason final bill and carried in the final balance; the termination is not counted as a default.
